clean_exploration.detail: Before the required control fetch, a repository-discovery code search exposed unrelated receipt filenames/metadata. No exposed non-evaluation semantics were used for evaluation work. After the control 404, only control metadata and evaluation-owned receipt metadata were inspected.

termination.reason: Required bootstrap control file is absent on current main, so current evaluation role configuration and Phase-1 desired state cannot be established safely.

exact_continuation: On any explicit future restart, fetch note/automation_control/DESIRED_STATE.json as the first repository read.
If it is still absent, perform no semantic work and persist a control-missing receipt only.
If present, execute only the current evaluation role config under clean_exploration and never edit DESIRED_STATE.json.
